subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp - scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Li <jessica.li@acmecorp.com>, Tim Bruner <tim.bruner@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & proposed dates — Eval kickoff for Acme Corp

Thanks again for the call this morning, Jessica + Tim — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: run a 2-week evaluation to validate Redwood inference on your core summarization and search workflows, measure latency/cost, and validate prompt-set quality.
- Success criteria (IV): average 95% parity on relevance evals vs your baseline, p50 latency < 200ms for 512-token prompts, and < 20% unit cost increase versus current plan (we'll finalize metrics in kickoff).
- Proposed kickoff: 60-minute technical kickoff to align trial plan, access, and prompt set/evals. Attendees: your ML + infra, our Solutions Engineering (Neha) and AE (Marissa).

Proposed windows (all in your timezone): 
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00am ET
- Wed May 5, 2:00–3:00pm ET
- Thu May 6, 11:00–12:00pm ET

Can you confirm any of the above or suggest alternatives? I uploaded a short draft eval plan and the initial prompt/account requirements (see attachment stub) — we can iterate in the kickoff.

Next steps (if we book kickoff):
- Share calendar invite + access checklist
- Assign success criteria and sample prompts
- Confirm security/infra contacts and data handling notes

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachment: eval_plan_v1.pdf (1 page, draft)

Thanks, Connor — this looks good. Appreciate the clear success criteria; we've got internal alignment on the high-level goals.

We can do Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00am ET. Please include the agenda and any pre-kickoff requests. Also, FYI: we'll want the SRE/infra folks on the call to vet networking and VPC/egress requirements.

I can confirm primary attendees now: myself (ML), Tim (Infra), and I'll loop in our Security contact if we need to cover SOC2/access details.

See you May 4 — send the invite when you have it.

—Jessica

Perfect — locking Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00am ET. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-eval-kickoff (pending)

Draft agenda (60min):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) Eval plan walkthrough: scope, datasets, and prompts (15m)
3) Access & infra checklist (Neha) (15m)
4) Success criteria & measurement (10m)
5) Timeline, responsibilities, next steps (10m)

Pre-kickoff asks (we'll cover these quickly at the start):
- Share a sample prompt set (5–10 prompts) + one representative dataset export (CSV) — you can drop to the Google Drive link or reply to this thread.
- Confirm SRE contact and any IP allowlist/egress constraints.
- If there are specific eval scripts you want us to run, attach or share the repo link.

I've attached a one-page eval plan and a quick requirements checklist for you to review (attachment stub). Neha will lead the infra portion and can follow up with an access checklist and temporary keys (if needed).

If that all looks good I'll send the invite and a HubSpot deal note (ACME-2027-EVAL-01).

Thanks — Connor

--
